register.description: Choose a passkey that protects your encrypted data on this device.
register.automaticDescription: Your passkey is generated automatically. You will then receive a backup code to download.
register.policyDescription: Please read and accept the usage policy before setting up your keychain.
register.acceptPolicy: I have read and accept this policy.

encryption.title: Welcome to HAWKI
encryption.body: From now on your chats are saved, so you can return to them at any time and from any device. Everything you write is encrypted before it leaves your browser. Nobody, not even your university, can read your conversations.

groups.title: Group chats
groups.body: In group chats, every member of the group can read your messages. That is the point of a group. Your content stays protected all the same: nobody outside the group can see it. Your data belongs to you alone.

passkey.title: Your passkey
passkey.body: In the next step you choose a personal passkey. Your chats are encrypted with it before they are stored on our server. You also need it when you sign in on a new device; this browser remembers it for you. At the end you can download a backup code in case you ever forget your passkey.

automaticPasskey.title: Your passkey and backup code
automaticPasskey.body: Your passkey is generated for you in the next step. Your chats are encrypted with it before they are stored on our server. This browser remembers the passkey for you. Afterwards you download a backup code, which unlocks your chats on any other device.

handshake.title: Unlock your keychain
handshake.description: Enter your passkey to decrypt your data on this device.
handshake.wrongPasskey: That passkey cannot unlock this keychain.
handshake.backupUnlockDescription: Enter your backup code to unlock your keychain on this device.
handshake.backupMissing: No backup code is available for this account.
handshake.ownPasskeyDescription: Enter the passkey you chose when you set up your keychain.
handshake.recoveryDescription: Enter the backup code you saved when you set up your keychain.

inconsistent.title: Your keychain needs attention
inconsistent.description: The encrypted keychain does not match this account. Reset the profile to create a new one.
inconsistent.automaticConfirmDescription: This permanently deletes your chats, existing keychain, and related profile data. Your keychain will then be created automatically and you will receive a new backup code. This cannot be undone.
inconsistent.confirmDescription: This permanently deletes your chats, encrypted keychain, passkey backup, and related profile data. You will then set up a new passkey and backup code. This cannot be undone.

auth.claim: Your conversations are encrypted. The key stays with you.
